hardware.variant: Luckfox Lyra Zero W, RK3506B, populated USB radio

inputs.name: EmberBSD evbarm GENERIC uImage
inputs.revision: 43b21cc0f147281408f01d159c02906506854374 with the receive-only station, USB queue and VIF cleanup changes integrated at ac98551b89980170d2cb34757ad5477be38943c0

inputs.name: EmberBSD multi-user FFS root
inputs.revision: earmv7hf with the BSD ifconfig wireless commands

scenario: Reboot from the multi-user serial shell with /sbin/reboot. Keep the microSD installed. Load the GENERIC kernel into RAM over UART0 with U-Boot loady. Check the received byte count and CRC32. Boot with the board DTB and microSD root. From the local root console, run ifconfig -l, ifconfig aicwf0 up, ifconfig aicwf0 list scan and ifconfig aicwf0.
expected: The station appears in the interface list and comes up. A scan result for an access point would confirm radio reception.
observed: The kernel mounted dk1 as FFS and attached aicwf0 at uaicfw0. The interface list included aicwf0. Bringing it up succeeded. The explicit scan command exited with status 0 and printed zero rows. The interface reported status: no network.
limits: One software reboot followed by a RAM-loaded kernel. The PCB revision is unknown.
The firmware status of the station creation request was not reported in this run. The command can read cached results even if the request for a new scan fails.
A zero-row result does not establish beacon reception. The receive-only driver has no association or data path. DHCP and SSH over Wi-Fi remain unverified.
